newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids higher.

text.p: Dark northern spring bids rose on Friday but dealers reported sporadic farm sales.

"Movement was kind of slow today, but with the (MGE) board up it might change this weekend," a Minneapolis dealer said. Farmers want $4.00 a bushel but usually it is anywhere between $3.80 to $3.90 that the farmer gets in his pocket, basis the Minneapolis spot bid for spring wheat, he said.
Wheat futures on all three exchanges, KCBT, CBOT and MGE, surged on Friday. March MGE futures jumped 9-1/2 cents to end at $4.03-3/4 a bushel.
A North Dakota merchandiser said favorable weather conditions allowed more soybeans, wheat and barley to move in the country. But in areas of Montana, farm sales were sparse, a Montana dealer said.
